summary:
**Astraea** is an interactive space mission architecture and flight operations simulator engineered for the NASA International Space Apps Challenge. Designed to transform abstract aerospace concepts into tangible gameplay for students and enthusiasts, the simulator covers the complete NASA mission lifecycle from initial formulation through interplanetary operations.

Players select from five scientifically authentic destinations, ranging from Earth climate monitoring and lunar south pole prospecting to deep-space Jovian Europa astrobiology. Across the engineering CAD workbench, participants navigate vital trade-offs between spacecraft chassis, nuclear or solar power systems governed by the solar flux inverse-square law, scientific instruments, communications link budgets, and propellant capacity calculated through the Tsiolkovsky rocket equation.

After configuring launch vehicles and orbital trajectory profiles, players initiate live mission execution. An animated Keplerian orbital canvas tracks real-time flight paths, Deep Space Network telemetry, velocity, distance, and spacecraft subsystems while presenting dynamic crisis dilemmas, including coronal mass ejections and reaction wheel anomalies.

Finally, an official evaluation review board assesses scientific discoveries, engineering safety margins, and fiscal budget discipline, culminating in a custom-generated, downloadable NASA embroidered mission patch.
